items.title: California AG cancels Paramount settlement meeting
items.summary: California Attorney General Rob Bonta reportedly canceled Monday's planned meeting with Paramount Skydance CEO David Ellison, accusing Paramount of leaking details of a prior meeting.

items.title: California Accuses Paramount Of 'A Lack Of Good Faith;' Calls Off Settlement Talks
items.summary: California Attorney General called off a planned meeting on Monday after alleging Paramount leaked details of previous discussions. Paramount Skydance stock fell about 2%, while Warner Bros. Discovery rose 1%.

items.title: California AG calls off Paramount settlement talks, accuses company of ‘playing games’
items.summary: California Attorney General Rob Bonta has canceled a meeting that was scheduled for Monday over Paramount’s planned $110 billion takeover of Warner Bros. Discovery, CNN’s parent company.
